title: VLM-Fuzz: Vision Language Model Assisted Recursive Depth-first Search Exploration for Effective GUI Testing of Android Apps

boundary.reason: Intra-Activity UI-hierarchy changes and layout geometry identify a transient popup; ADB executes actions and a host-Activity/tree check confirms return from the transient state.

structured_items.item: GUI hierarchy XML class, text, clickable, scrollable, sibling index, widget id, Activity and bounds
structured_items.normalized_field: role_or_class + name_or_text + actionability + hierarchy + owner + bounds

structured_items.item: pre/post interactive-element diff, host hierarchy diff and transition/replay record

visual_items.item: screenshot with numbered interactive widgets and VLM event sequence
visual_items.notes: Only used on complex input screens; popup detection itself is tree-based.

context_items.item: host/current Activity, transient-state type, visit counter and transition stack

detection: If Activity is unchanged but interactive elements differ, compute the new layout box; a screen-edge gap over 150 px marks a transient popup.
action_selection: Traverse clickable/scroll/menu actions; order neutral, positive, negative, then Exit/Back/Cancel. VLM handles text-input screens on demand.
execution: Map XML widgets to ADB events.
verification: When the popup closes, confirm return to the host Activity and diff the host hierarchy; a jump to another Activity is a transition, not a dismissal.
dataset_or_sample_source: 59 AndroTest apps, five 60-minute runs; additional recent Play Store apps.
reported_popup_metrics: No popup-specific precision or success; global coverage numbers are not popup metrics.
limitations: Tree exposure and 150-pixel heuristic limit coverage.
Exploration actions are not safe user-intent actions.
No screen-reader focus or task-postcondition verification.

source_evidence.supports: raw hierarchy fields, discovery rule, execution and host-return verification.

public_sources.supports: Peer-reviewed Empirical Software Engineering article.
Public versioned preprint and paper metadata.
